title: Thing
description: JSON Schema for a thing — the polysemous wrapper for the categorical primitive when discussed in 561 OS contexts. Every thing IS an object (Lambek 1958; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I); the polysemy is in which kind-name is in scope (structure, character, transformer, category, theory, object, directory, program, system, intelligence, carrier, cell, stratum). The schema specializes object via allOf with no additional cells: the polysemy lives in naming convention, not in schema content. Specializing structures (transformer, library, etc.) add their own cells via further allOf.
